reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that notifies users through native Windows, macOS, or Linux system notifications when goals complete or agent turns end, with configurable triggers and rate limiting.

summaries.zh: 在目标完成或智能体回合结束时，通过 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 原生系统通知提醒用户。
summaries.en: Displays native Windows, macOS, or Linux system notifications when a goal completes or an agent turn ends.

capabilities: Displays native operating system notifications when configured task events occur
Executes platform-specific notification commands including PowerShell, osascript, and notify-send
Writes notification content to temporary files and records events in a local audit log
Registers a Windows AppUserModelID under the current user registry hive
